brut.title: 16 Things Only A Manchester United Fan Will Relate To

webpage.text:
16 Things Only A Manchester United Fan Will Relate To

Your connection with Manchester United dates back to the day you first kicked a ball. You grew up listening to the glories of Manchester United, remembering the treble of ’99 or buying a new kit every year. Every fan has his way of celebrating the god-like stature of Manchester United. Seeing the unfortunate last season made you face the bum-chums of Man United. But this season, the team is prepared with the likes of new manager Louis Van Gaal and you are ready to shout out victory, while they get the 21st championship.

1. You’ve been criticized for the ‘fantastic’ performance by the former manager David Moyes. And this season you would like to shut those mouths up because you believe in Van Gaal.

2. You know everything about Ander Harrera and Luke Shaw by now. Even about their place of birth and their girlfriends.

3. You automatically go under the weather hearing about these dates – 06th Feb, 1958 and 08th May, 2013. And you feel overjoyed by remembering 21st May, 2008 and the treble of ’99.

4. You own at least one memento that shows your support for Man United. And this does NOT include anything wearable.

5. You know about the origin of the nickname “Red Devils”. And no, it is not because they wear a red jersey!

© konuralpleventart (dot) deviantart (dot) com

6. Your bucket list includes catching a Man United-Arsenal game or Manchester Derby or Man United-Liverpool game at the Old Trafford with your best friend before you die.

7. It’s not Alex Ferguson or Fergie; it’s Sir Alex and you’d probably kill anyone if he uses any of the prior names. He is indeed a God to you!

8. You have seen ‘Looking for Eric’, ‘United’, or ‘Class of 92’ at least 10 times or more!

9. Prawn Sandwich Brigade? Yeah you know what it is!

10. 20 is your favorite number! 21 will be after this season!

11. How to spot a pseudo Manchester United fan? Just say MAN-U, if he goes with it, curse him because it’s always Man United.

© soccer (dot) indonewyork (dot) com

12. Some part of you still wants him to come back!

13. You’re probably baffled by Manchester City fans – Just why Man City?

14. You envy these guys like anything!

15. Best Counter Attack! Yeah!


16. And lastly, you know this by heart! Glory Glory Man United!

Photo: © facebook  (Main Image)

获得英超冠军最多的球队？曼市双雄称霸，利物浦阿森纳无缘前三_赛季_曼彻斯特联队_联赛

原创 获得英超冠军最多的球队？曼市双雄称霸，利物浦阿森纳无缘前三

2024-01-17 08:35 来源: 阮政

发布于：山西省

#百家快评#

英超联赛自1992年2月20日诞生起，便成为了全球足球的焦点，在这30年里群雄逐鹿，但最成功的无疑是曼彻斯特联队，他们以无人可挡的气势，13次问鼎英超联赛，在弗格森爵士的带领下，曼联傲视整个足坛，自弗格森爵士离去后，曼联再无问鼎过英超冠军。


自1992-1993赛季英超改制以来，曼联队凭借其实力和稳坐英超冠军宝座，成为了获得冠军最多的俱乐部。截至2021-2022赛季，曼联队共斩获了13个英超冠军，傲视群雄，紧随其后的是曼城队，同样具有强大的实力和稳定的发挥，截至2021-2022赛季他们获得了6个英超冠军。除此之外，切尔西队获得了5个英超冠军，阿森纳队获得了3个，利物浦队、布莱克本队和莱斯特城队各获得了1个。


阿森纳队史三次英超冠军年份分别是：1997/98、2001/02、2003/04。在1997/98赛季，阿森纳首次在英超夺冠，这是法国主帅温格执教的第二个赛季，也是他22年枪手主帅生涯中的第年。2001/02赛季，阿森纳成为英超历史上唯一一支不败夺冠的球队，创造了传奇。而2003/04赛季，是温格在阿森纳的最后一个英超冠军，也是球队迄今为止最后一次英超夺冠。

在切尔西队史上，阿布的贡献不可磨灭。他带领切尔西共夺得5次英超冠军，几乎占据了球队历史的一半荣誉。在2004/05、2005/06、2009/10、2014/15和2016/17这五个赛季里，阿布为切尔西带来了辉煌的胜利。他的到来，不仅让切尔西成为了英超的霸主，更引领了整个联赛进入了金元足球的新时代。

曼城队史辉煌，曾9次问鼎英格兰低级联赛冠军，而在英超赛场上，他们同样以7次冠军傲视群雄。这7个英超冠军，无一不是金元足球的见证。回溯曼城的英超冠军赛季：2011-12、2013-14、2017-18、2018-19、-21、2021-22以及刚刚获得的2022-23赛季冠军，其中5个冠军是由传奇主帅瓜迪奥拉率队夺得。

自1986年起，弗格森肩负起了曼彻斯特联队的重任，他的教鞭长达27年，一直引领着球队走向复兴之路。在英超改制之后，他带领曼联勇夺首个英超冠军，打破了曼联25年无冠的历史。这位传奇教练，正是他的执着和理念，铸就了曼联今日的辉煌。

The Premier League started on February 20, 1992. Manchester United won 13 titles under Sir Alex Ferguson. Manchester City won 7 titles, Chelsea won 5 titles under Abramovich, Arsenal won 3 titles under Arsène Wenger (including the 2003/04 unbeaten season), and Liverpool, Blackburn, and Leicester City won 1 title each. Pep Guardiola has won 5 titles with Manchester City.
